observations.behavior: Adds a monkeypatch to a warehouse workflow activity test, explicitly disabling the '_start_to_close_deadline_passed' check.
observations.posthog_connection: This could allow warehouse ingestion workflows to proceed even when the configured start-to-close deadline has passed, potentially bypassing a timeout or completion check. This is a test-only change; its production equivalent is not supplied.

observations.behavior: Removes 'loop_context_internal' from the set of server-minted scope objects, replacing it with 'context_layer_internal' in the MCP service.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the OAuth scope configuration for the MCP service. This could affect which scopes are considered 'server-minted' and thus available to the MCP agent. The replacement scope is not supplied, making it impossible to assess the functional impact.
